headline: Approved Act 127 resolution on equitable data driven funding and Superintendent Flanagan's 2026-27 professional goals.
summary: The board approved sending a revised resolution on equitable data driven funding to the VSBA for consideration at its August 2026 meeting. The board also approved Superintendent Flanagan's professional goals for the 2026-27 school year. The board also received VSBA training materials on policy governance, open meeting law, and board goals.
decisions: Approved sending a revised and retitled resolution called Equitable Data Driven Funding to the VSBA for consideration at its August '26 board meeting.
Approved Superintendent Flanagan's professional goals for the 2026-27 school year.
